comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
start smaller than the word AI makes it sound. pick one boring rule you can write in a sentence, check it on old data, then run it on paper for a month before any real money. most of what gets sold as AI in finance is a screener with a chat box on top.

if you want somewhere free to do the paper part, Quantradin at quantradin.com is mine, I built it for that stage. paper accounts only, so the mistakes are cheap while you learn.
